claims.claim_text: The image-level manipulation score is very high (0.999).
claims.brief_justification: A detector score value; not checkable against the supplied imagery.

claims.claim_text: The localization measurements indicate significant areas of concern.
claims.brief_justification: Vague restatement of detector output; asserts nothing independently checkable beyond the location.

claims.claim_text: Those areas are in the 'center-right' region.
claims.brief_justification: IMAGE C contains two narrow horizontal blobs, both lying almost entirely in the middle-right cell with only a ~35 px sliver crossing into centre; IMAGE D's outlines sit in the same band.

claims.claim_text: Those areas have high mean and maximum probabilities of manipulation.
claims.brief_justification: Restates numeric detector output; the mask conveys extent, not probabilities.

The outlined background vehicle differs markedly between the images: IMAGE A shows a cream coach with a red pinstripe and broad yellow and green lower bands on rubber tyres, while at the same position IMAGE B shows a white rail vehicle with a continuous dark window band, roof-mounted equipment and no yellow/green striping. The content in the marked band has been changed.

notes: Location matches the mask, and the A-versus-B comparison of the outlined background vehicle shows a substantively different vehicle and livery, supporting the alteration conclusion. The explanation names no object and cites no visible artefact of its own; the region is small, distant and hazy, which limits how precisely the change can be characterised.
